name: solution-faq
description: FAQ accordion of the solution pages: a centred heading over ruled questions with a plus/minus mark. Live: the .epx-faq section on the solution pages, Emergency Preparedness, School Reunification and Help Desk (rules ported).

tone.description: Section background: the grey-to-white gradient of the solution pages, or plain white (pricing page).

items.description: Questions. Each: q (question) and a (answer). Line breaks in the answer are kept; UrsaAI is styled as the brand mark.

variant.description: solution: the six solution pages (questions are h3, tighter bottom space). readiness: Emergency Preparedness and School Reunification (deeper bottom space, answers flush under the question). service: Help Desk.

open_first.description: Start with the first question open (the solution pages do).

schema.description: Also output FAQPage structured data for these questions. Use on one FAQ per page.
